payload.summary: Targeted IMPL_FIX resolved all round-1 blocking and deterministic critical/high findings, plus the related bounded low-risk issues. Independent inspection found and closed an additional empty-store stale-manifest variant. The complete supervise suite, lint, installed-skill sync check, strict OpenSpec validation, and diff integrity all pass.
completed_work: Retained unscored lifecycle survivors while preserving terminal pruning and later scoring retry
Added validated no-dispatch reuse for forced same-fingerprint cycles and a zero-candidate fast path
Made transaction recovery fail closed until host rehydration and normalized due decisions across prepare/rank
Bound ranking manifests byte-for-byte to the persisted store, including the empty-store case
Normalized staleness timestamps to UTC and made git evidence pathspecs literal
Migrated legacy supervisor-record fixtures and hardened canonical durable-record sanitization
Added direct regressions for all reviewed behaviors and synchronized workflow documentation

decisions.title: Require exact persisted-store identity at rank time
decisions.rationale: A manifest is valid only when its key set and candidate bytes exactly match current persisted state; an empty store cannot authorize a stale non-empty manifest.

decisions.title: Fail closed after transaction recovery
decisions.rationale: Stopping for rehydration prevents a recovered mirror from being overwritten by stale host-owned record state later in the same command sequence.

next_steps: Run implementation review round 2 against the complete branch
Proceed to validate-feature only after review convergence
